question: What level of Vedic mastery and knowledge is certainly attained through this practice?
premises: The practitioner becomes skilled in the meaning of all Vedas.
The practitioner becomes possessed of knowledge.
This outcome is stated as certain.
inference: The practice certainly makes one skilled in the meaning of all Vedas and possessed of knowledge.
plain_english: One certainly becomes skilled in the meaning of all the Vedas and possessed of knowledge.
